quote: Since it has pleased Providence to place me in this station, I shall do my utmost to fulfil my duty towards my country; I am very young and perhaps in many, though not in all things, inexperienced, but I am sure that very few have more real goodwill and more real desire to do what is fit and right than I have.
source: Queen Victoria, The Queen’s Journal, 20 June 1837, in The Letters of Queen Victoria, vol. I, ch. VI (John Murray, 1907)
